identity: The Westminster Shorter Catechism and the Westminster Larger Catechism into one single large, hardcover book.  It serves as the doctrinal standard in the Reformed tradition of Protestant Christianity, a concise and systematic summary of Christian beliefs, intended to be used for teaching and instruction (and also one of the Four Forms of Unity, depending on the denomination).  This catechism is also divided into a series of questions and answers, covering various aspects of theology, morality, and Christian living.
